title: More control over your notes
summary: Organise notes together, snooze reminders, revisit earlier text and see more clearly what is saved on your device or waiting to sync.

items: Select notes with Ctrl-click, Shift-click or a mouse drag, then right-click to move, trash, restore or export the selection.
Undo a move to Trash immediately without leaving your workspace.
Snooze a reminder for five minutes, fifteen minutes, one hour or a custom time. The new schedule stays saved after restarting and syncs when enabled.

Note history is tucked into each note’s right-click menu and optionally keeps earlier titles and text on this device. Review a version before restoring it. History is off by default, has clear storage limits and can be cleared at any time.
Review new sync conflicts side by side. Keep both versions, open the preserved copy to combine changes yourself, or use its text in the original note.
Local saving and cloud sync have separate status messages, including the last successful note sync and changes waiting to upload.
If local saving fails, keep Scribe open to retry or use recovery tools to copy the current text and export notes still held in memory.
Large note collections render fewer cards at once, and search reuses prepared text to keep browsing more responsive. Word counts and reading estimates give typing priority.
Searching in Trash now filters deleted notes correctly.
When another Scribe window blocks a storage upgrade, a useful explanation replaces an indefinite wait.
Sync messages choose their recovery actions from the type of problem, so changing message wording does not remove the correct actions.
Permanently deleting a note removes its local history. Clearing local workspace data also removes its history and conflict-review records.
